name: @pipeworx/mcp-nasa-firms

tools.name: firms_hotspots_area
tools.description: "Where are the wildfires in California right now" / "active fire detections over Greece this week" — satellite thermal-anomaly (active fire) detections inside a bounding box, from NASA FIRMS. AUTHORITATIVE for where something is actually burning right now: these are pixels a MODIS or VIIRS sensor measured as hot, published within ~3 hours of overpass, not a news report about a fire. Returns latitude/longitude, acquisition date and UTC time, brightness temperature, fire radiative power (MW), confidence, satellite and day/night flag. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for current fire locations and extent.

bbox.description: Bounding box as "west,south,east,north" in decimal degrees, e.g. "-125,32,-114,42" for California. Use "world" for the whole globe (large). Maximum extent -180,-90,180,90.

source.description: Satellite product. "VIIRS_SNPP_NRT" (default, 375 m, global, near-real-time), "VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT", "VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT", "MODIS_NRT" (1 km, longest record), "LANDSAT_NRT" (30 m, US/Canada only), or the "_SP" standard-processing variants for the quality-controlled archive.

day_range.description: Number of days to return, 1-5 (default 1). Counted forward from `date`, or backward from today when `date` is omitted.

date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the most recent data.

tools.name: firms_hotspots_near
tools.description: "Are there any fires near Boulder, Colorado?" / "active fire detections within 50 km of this point" — NASA FIRMS satellite hotspot detections around a latitude/longitude, sorted nearest first with the distance in km. Same measured detections as firms_hotspots_area, addressed the way a question about a place is actually asked. Returns distance_km, position, acquisition time, brightness temperature, fire radiative power and confidence.

source.description: Satellite product. "VIIRS_SNPP_NRT" (default, 375 m, global, near-real-time), "VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT", "VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT", "MODIS_NRT" (1 km, longest record), "LANDSAT_NRT" (30 m, US/Canada only), or the "_SP" standard-processing variants for the quality-controlled archive.

date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the most recent data.

tools.name: firms_data_availability
tools.description: Which dates each NASA FIRMS satellite product actually covers — the first and last date available per sensor, for near-real-time and standard-processing streams. Call this before querying a historical date so an empty hotspot result can be read as "outside the archive" rather than "no fires".

source.description: A single product id (see firms_hotspots_area) or "ALL" for every sensor (default).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nasa-firms forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nasa-firms pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
